WITH s AS (
 SELECT f.*, st.format, st.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key)
 WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND st.store_id<900),
r AS (SELECT sales_line_id, count(*) n, sum(quantity_returned) q, sum(refund_net) rn, sum(refund_gross) rg FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.format, count(*) lines, sum(s.net_amount) sold_net, sum(r.rn) refunded_net, 100*sum(r.rn)/sum(s.net_amount) pct,
 count(r.sales_line_id) ret_lines, sum(CASE WHEN r.n>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi, sum(CASE WHEN r.q>s.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) overq,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.rn>s.net_amount+0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) overamt, sum(CASE WHEN s.quantity<=0 OR s.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING(sales_line_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT st.format, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id>=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pseudo
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH p AS (
  SELECT period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 2
),
sold AS (
  SELECT st.format, f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, f.staff_purchase_flag
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date
  WHERE st.store_id < 900
),
ret AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) refund_net, sum(quantity_returned) units_ret FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, s.format AS store_format,
  round(100 * sum(coalesce(r.refund_net, 0)) / sum(s.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
  round(100 * sum(coalesce(r.refund_net, 0)) FILTER (WHERE NOT s.staff_purchase_flag) / sum(s.net_amount) FILTER (WHERE NOT s.staff_purchase_flag), 2) AS ex_staff_pct,
  round(100 * sum(coalesce(r.units_ret, 0)) / sum(s.quantity), 2) AS unit_pct
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN ret r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY s.format ORDER BY CASE s.format WHEN 'Large' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
